items.en: Cards show a skeleton while they load.
items.zh: 卡片加载时显示骨架占位。

items.en: Every "Add course" button now offers the same choices as the new-term wizard: enter courses manually, continue a full-year course from last term, or import them from a calendar file, syllabus, screenshot, pasted text or your LMS.
items.zh: 所有「添加课程」按钮都提供与新建学期向导相同的方式：手动填写、延续上学期的全年课，或从日历文件、Syllabus、截图、粘贴文本和 LMS 导入。

items.en: When no AI provider is set up, Sem shows the setup prompt directly instead of briefly showing the chat first.
items.zh: 未配置 AI 服务商时，Sem 直接显示配置提示，不再先闪现聊天界面。

items.en: The provider list in the Add provider dialog now fills the full width.
items.zh: “添加服务商”对话框中的服务商列表现在占满整行宽度。

items.en: When adding a known compatible service, its address, model and capabilities now sit under a lighter "Endpoint settings" section.
items.zh: 添加已知的兼容服务时，接口地址、模型和能力改为放在更简洁的「接口设置」折叠区中。
